design_brief.problem_statement: Live V0 Construction can advance without proving and exactly consuming the canonical ore produced by P3 mining.
design_brief.current_behavior: Existing Construction atomic transaction machinery exists, but exact material-stack exhaustion is rejected by BuildPlan and the stage planner/validator cannot represent material exhaustion as DELETE + CONSUME_MATERIAL; live M4 wiring is not yet completed.
design_brief.desired_behavior: A server-authoritative build request deterministically allocates the requesting player's eligible canonical ore, atomically debits or deletes those stacks together with the Construction commit, publishes canonical changes, and reconstructs the same result on reconnect.
alternatives_considered: Separate inventory debit then Construction command
Client-owned affordability or a new resource_balance counter
Reuse the existing atomic Construction transaction boundary with the live M4 Item Graph
design_brief.selected_design: Reuse ConstructionBuildProcess, ConstructionStageTransactionPlanner and AuthoritativeConstructionItemGraphAdapter. Implement exact exhaustion as DELETE + CONSUME_MATERIAL, then add deterministic server allocation and bind the existing transaction boundary to the same live M4 Item Graph store.
design_brief.why_selected: It closes the economy loop with one canonical Item Graph and one Construction owner while preserving existing atomic rollback/idempotency machinery.
dependencies: authoritative CONTINUE audit committed before Director dispatch
expected_risks: Partial commit between Item Graph and Construction
Publication or reconnect divergence after atomic commit
validation_plan: Prove exact-consume RED on the pre-fix subject
Apply only the prepared three-file P4.1 patch and prove focused GREEN on Godot 4.7.1 double
Exercise the live M4 transaction port with sufficient/insufficient/replay/conflict/fault/ownership cases
Run two-client replication and reconnect convergence
Run standard/directional PC0 and independent HIGH-risk review/verification
